### Round 1 - Track T1 (GitHub code search for SKILL.md across product-design topics)

**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Platforms:** github.com search (repositories), GitHub topic pages (claude-skills, claude-code-skills, agent-skills), officialskills.sh, grep.app (blocked), sourcegraph.com (blocked).

**Access notes:** grep.app API returns HTTP 429 with a Vercel bot challenge on every request (verified via curl: `x-vercel-mitigated: challenge`) - unusable without a browser. Sourcegraph unauthenticated search returns 403. GitHub code search (type=code) requires login, so all GitHub work went through repository search, topic pages, and direct repo opens. gh CLI not used per instructions.

**Queries run (19):** three grep.app attempts (blocked); topics claude-skills (7,505 repos), claude-code-skills (1,592), agent-skills; GitHub repo searches for: accessibility audit (113), "design system" (507 - the richest family), user research/usability testing, heuristic evaluation/design critique (3,100), wireframe/prototype, conversational UX/AI interface/agentic UI, information architecture (5 - starved category), product analytics/instrumentation (no dedicated hits), microcopy/ux writing, design review/visual regression/design qa, typography/color palette/visual hierarchy, figma skill SKILL.md (9); one Sourcegraph query (403).

**Verified candidates (25):** anthropics/skills (frontend-design, canvas-design, theme-factory, brand-guidelines, webapp-testing; Apache-2.0, 171.7k); Leonxlnx/taste-skill (MIT, 80.8k); cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT, 27.1k); JimLiu/baoyu-design (MIT, 3.6k); microsoft/skills frontend-design-review (MIT, 3k); Trystan-SA/claude-design-system-prompt (MIT, 1.9k - convertible, not SKILL.md standard); cookiy-ai/user-research-skill (MIT, 1.5k - partial service tether); plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills (MIT, 769 - 17-skill pack); staruhub/ClaudeSkills product-manager (MIT, 705); Railly/tinte (MIT, 613 - SKILL.md compiler); AThevon/genjutsu (MIT, 287); originaleric/dig-ui-skill (Apache-2.0, 229); arvindrk/extract-design-system (MIT, 189); senlindesign/claude2figma (MIT, 186); jiji262/claude-design-skill (MIT, 184); murphytrueman/design-system-ops (MIT, 164); content-designer/ux-writing-skill (MIT, 155); southleft/figma-console-mcp-skills (MIT, 73 - 22 skills); Ashutos1997/claude-design-auditor-skill (MIT, 75 - includes ethics checks); Magdoub/claude-wireframe-skill (MIT, 69); EliaAlberti/ux-audit-skill (MIT, 17); airowe/claude-a11y-skill (unknown license, 14); zivtech/accessibility-skills (GPL-3.0-or-later, 6 - full a11y lifecycle); wonjyou/design-audit (unknown, 4 - rare IA coverage); google-labs-code/design-md (verified via officialskills.sh page; repo not opened directly).
